origin.description: Compare the partial sums of a demeaned or detrended series with a Bartlett long-run variance.
origin.usage: ur.kpss(y, type = c("mu", "tau"), lags = c("short", "long", "nil"), use.lag = NULL)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: A numeric series. Missing values are dropped.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: mu removes the mean. tau removes a linear trend.

arguments.name: lags
arguments.text: short, long, or nil. short is trunc(4 (n/100)^0.25). long uses 12. nil uses no lag.

arguments.name: use.lag
arguments.text: A non-negative integer that replaces the lag rule. A negative value falls back to short.

origin.details: The numerator is the sum of squared partial sums, divided by n squared. The denominator is the residual variance plus the Bartlett-weighted autocovariances. A nil lag leaves the denominator at that variance.
origin.value: The KPSS statistic and the four critical values for the chosen type.
